olivia (AE): Quick heads-up — Aurelia asked for a co-sell demo + short POC for Acme Bank next week. They want a staging tenant, SAML SSO, and an enterprise pricing ballpark. Can we assemble a runbook?
raj (SE): I can own infra steps. Need to confirm whether we use Dedicated or Hosted for the POC. Any compliance box ticks from Acme?
julia (Aurelia): Acme requires customer-managed keys and SC-2 baseline. They're okay with hosted if traffic stays within EU, but want audit logs forwarded.
kai (Infra): For KMS + audit, recommend Redwood Private in their VPC, but that adds ops time. If timeline is tight we can do Hosted + VPN tunnel and forward logs to their SIEM. ETA for provisioning Dedicated pool ~ 5 business days.
olivia (AE): Timeline is tight: demo w/ security team Thurs (5 days). Can we do a minimal hosted POC that meets their requirements?
raj (SE): Minimal path: Hosted with egress restricted to eu-west, SAML SSO + scoped API key for tenant, and ship Audit webhook -> Aurelia SIEM. I can draft config steps.
sam (Security): Need to run the short security questionnaire and provide ATO-ish checklist. Also they asked about data retention and KV cache persistence — we need to confirm tokens not stored in logs.
nate (Solutions): I'll collect the questionnaire. Can someone paste the SAML metadata example we use?
raj (SE): Sure. Paste for SAML config (IdP metadata -> SP):
```
EntityID: https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml
ACS: https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/consume
x509: -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
raj (SE): For Hosted POC, config steps: 1) create tenant, 2) enable SAML, 3) set IP allowlist, 4) create scoped API key with read/write limits, 5) enable audit webhook to Aurelia endpoint. I'll put exact CLI snippets after this thread.
julia (Aurelia): We'll provide SP metadata and SIEM endpoint. Question on pricing: can you give a 2-week evaluation credit or temporary discounted rate for Dedicated if we need to flip?
olivia (AE): We typically offer 30% credit for short co-sell POCs but need approval for Dedicated discounts. I'll loop in sales ops.
sam (Security): Also flag: Acme asked whether we support HSM-backed keys. Hosted can't provide customer HSM. For the demo we'll document the gap and an architecture for Private deployment with KMS/HSM.
kai (Infra): If we keep things hosted, we can still demonstrate telemetry and audit exports. For HSM discussion, prepare a one-pager showing Private deployment steps and expected timeline.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for staging-tenant-2401. Status: queued -> provisioning infra.
raj (SE): Action items: I'll draft the infra runbook (provisioning + rollback) and CLI snippets. Nate — can you own the questionnaire collation and forward to Sam?
nate (Solutions): On it. I'll pull the latest SIG questionnaire and the ATO checklist and tag Acme's compliance contact.
julia (Aurelia): Also want a short demo script focusing on latency, cost-per-token, and failover to smaller model if capacity constrained. Can your SE show automatic fallback?
raj (SE): Yes — we can show routing policy: primary redwood-llm-x -> fallback redwood-llm-small with policy snippet. Example config: `routing: { primary: model-x, fallback: model-x-quantized }`. I'll include the perf numbers.
olivia (AE): Thanks. Two blockers: 1) Dedicated discount approval, 2) final SSO metadata. If both are solved by EOD tomorrow we can hit Thurs.
sam (Security): I'll review questionnaire by EOD. If anything high-risk shows up, we'll need legal sign-off which could delay.
julia (Aurelia): We'll prioritize SSO metadata today. Also can you send a short privacy/data flow diagram for Acme's security team?
nate (Solutions): I'll draft a one-page data flow (no PHI) and post link when ready.
raj (SE): I'll also capture telemetry dashboard screenshots and a short run-through doc for the demo.
olivia (AE): Great — assigning owners in comments: raj=infra runbook, nate=questionnaire + data flow, sam=security sign-off, olivia=discount approval. Let's reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PST for a dry run.
julia (Aurelia): 10:30 PST works. Thanks everyone :) :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staging-tenant-2401 provisioning started (resource allocation 2/4 GPUs).
